participantInstructions: The event will be presented to you through your reading of the 21st Century Skills, the Performance Indicators, and the Case Study Situation below. As a participant team, you will have up to 30 minutes to review the case, discuss your approach, and prepare your presentation. You will then have up to 15 minutes to present your recommendation to the judge and respond to the judge's questions. Both members of the participant team must take part in the presentation and in answering the judge's questions. You will be evaluated on how well you meet each of the performance indicators listed for this event. Turn in all notes and materials to the judge when your presentation and questions are complete.
situation:
You and your partner serve as the director of risk management and the director of retail operations at BRISTLECONE TOY IMPORTS, a regional importer and wholesaler of children's toys preparing its first location outside its home state. The chief financial officer (judge) has called you in to help settle an unresolved question that is holding up the new location's opening and to recommend how the company should proceed.

Bristlecone spent sixteen years supplying independent toy retailers before opening its own distribution center and, later, direct import relationships with overseas manufacturers. That center anchors the business today. A second facility opening this quarter in a neighboring state is meant to carry that same model into a new region for the first time, and its shelves are meant to be filled from inventory currently staged at the home center.

Three weeks ago, a sprinkler head in the home center released water overnight onto pallets bound for both facilities, soaking cartons of imported toys. The insurer's adjuster inspected the fitting and openly told Bristlecone that two readings both hold up: corrosion consistent with gradual wear the policy's wear-and-tear exclusion would deny, and a water-flow volume consistent with a sudden rupture the policy would cover. Bristlecone's maintenance file agrees with neither side outright; a technician flagged a minor drip eight months ago, then closed the ticket as resolved with no leak found on a later visit.

The chief financial officer (judge) wants a recommendation: accept the insurer's early offer of a reduced payout now, or file the formal appeal the policy allows and pursue the claim's full value. The new facility's opening weekend has already been promoted as part of the region's autumn festival weekend using the package-and-tour approach common in hospitality marketing, and that festival-weekend opening date depends on inventory the payout would fund.

Accepting the offer releases cash in time for that opening weekend but closes the claim permanently, leaving this quarter's shortfall to be absorbed from money already set aside for next quarter's holiday reorder. Appealing could recover the full amount, but the insurance department's review process can run for months, during which the opening would have to be financed through Bristlecone's line of credit at its own ongoing cost.

The soaked cartons ruled a total loss must also be disposed of under the state's disposal rules for inventory containing batteries and electronics, and the warehouse crew, kept off that section since the incident, is waiting to hear what the company decides. The chief financial officer (judge) will greet you and ask you to present your recommendation. Be ready to explain your reasoning, how you would communicate it to the crew, and what the company should expect afterward. The judge will thank you both once your presentation and questions are complete.
judgeCharacterization:
You are the chief financial officer at BRISTLECONE TOY IMPORTS. Business background is the same as the situation above. You called this meeting because the unresolved insurance question is holding up funding for the company's first out-of-state location, and you need the participant team's recommendation on whether Bristlecone should accept the insurer's reduced early offer or pursue the claim's full value through the formal appeal the policy allows.

You will greet the participant team and ask them to share their ideas. Ask the following questions after their presentation:
judgeQuestions: If we take the insurer's early offer, what happens next quarter when the holiday reorder comes due?
If we appeal instead, what happens to the opening weekend if the insurer's review runs long?
How would you explain this decision to the warehouse crew?
